items.title: Tanner McKee: Benched for Joe Milton in Week 9
items.text:
McKee will shift to a backup role for Sunday's game against the Giants with the Eagles set to move forward with Joe Milton as their starting quarterback in Week 9, Adam Schefter of ESPN and Mike Garafolo of NFL Network report.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Joe Milton: Set to start Sunday
items.text:
Milton is set to be the Eagles' starting quarterback Sunday against the Giants, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: David Montgomery: Not seen at practice
items.text:
Montgomery (groin) wasn't present for the portion of Wednesday's practice open to the media, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

items.title: Drew Lock: Set to start Sunday
items.text:
Lock (elbow) is slated to start Sunday's game against the Cardinals, perNFL reporter Andrew Siciliano.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Won't play in Week 9
items.text:
Head coach Mike Macdonald announced that Darnold won't play Sunday against the Cardinals due to a quadriceps injury, NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano reports.
